hypothesis: Resolution labels alone understate capital lock duration; cash is available only after an attributable credit receipt.
scope: Pure accounting foundation for queued Settlement-Latency Capital Efficiency work; no strategy selection or executable edge claim.
observations: No market outcomes consumed by this implementation; tests are synthetic only.

frozen_parameters.availability: actual local receipt time, never backdated exchange economic time
frozen_parameters.capital_release: one explicit complete attributable cash-credit receipt per entry, including zero losing settlement
frozen_parameters.capacity: all debit receipts before credit receipts at identical timestamp
frozen_parameters.delay_summary: median credited_at minus resolved_at using only credit receipts available by cutoff
frozen_parameters.missing_credit: capital remains locked, net outcome unknown
frozen_parameters.unsupported: partial credits, offsets, event collateral netting, short inventory, negative credits, unowned or duplicate cash identity

automatic_rejection: Reject nonfinite values, impossible chronology, duplicate ownership/credit, negative cash capacity; never infer a credit from a settlement label.
next_evidence_gate: An independently reconciled fixed cohort with authentic fill/fee, resolution and cash-credit receipts. Missing provenance remains blocked. No economic strategy test or profitability sample is registered here.
integration: offline module only; no worker import, network, broker, scheduler or execution interface
